name: flexfactor
guidance: Existing pyproject.toml setuptools backend and CI wheel command; Android Gradle project with documented Gradle 8.13, JDK 21, Android SDK 36 and build-tools 35.0.0. Python package output is a wheel, not a Windows EXE or macOS app. Android output is a debug APK, not a signed store release.

windows.format: Python wheel (requires Python >=3.12 and separately installed runtime dependencies)
windows.notice: Portable Python package; target is recipient intent, not native OS certification. Windows/Linux have existing CI; macOS runtime remains unverified.

linux.format: Python wheel (requires Python >=3.12 and separately installed runtime dependencies)
linux.notice: Portable Python package; target is recipient intent, not native OS certification. Windows/Linux have existing CI; macOS runtime remains unverified.

macos.format: Python wheel (requires Python >=3.12 and separately installed runtime dependencies)
macos.notice: Portable Python package; target is recipient intent, not native OS certification. Windows/Linux have existing CI; macOS runtime remains unverified.

android.notice: Requires preinstalled Gradle 8.13, JDK 21, Android SDK 36/build tools 35.0.0 and cached Gradle dependencies. Offline build does not provision missing tools.
